summary: Turned the last inference inside the finding's mechanism into a sourced fact. The claim that nobody ever proposed the leave-joint entry rested on the auto-leave branch requiring leadership at apply time, and the source states it exactly: at raft.go:742 the branch is `r.trk.Config.AutoLeave && newApplied >= r.pendingConfIndex && r.state == StateLeader`, after which appliedTo steps a proposal built by confChangeToMsg(nil), whose own comment notes that only an in-progress leadership transfer can drop it. So a node that applies a joint-entering change while it is not the leader never proposes the leave, and the leader that proposed the change can only propose the leave if it is still leader when it applies its own entry - meaning a joint configuration entered under a leader that loses leadership before applying it stays joint until some later leader applies that entry, and every node that has already applied it holds a joint configuration in the meantime. Recorded as behaviour knowledge with its source ranges (appliedTo and the configuration-change path) and the leader-side/follower-side conditions, so the mechanism no longer depends on an unobserved step except which proposal was displaced; that remainder stays in the interpretation's counterevidence and the election-to-stale-state path is still source-argued. No experiment was requested this turn: the fact is a source statement about a guard the existing receipts already exercised indirectly, and the decoded-history receipt plus the deterministic guard receipt already carry the observed halves.
